//: Repo root config. The Astro project lives in site/, so this file drives the build from the repository root and no Root Directory setting is required. If Root Directory is ever set to site/, this file stops applying and the settings move with it.
buildCommand: cd site && npx playwright install chromium && npm run build

headers.//: Generated sheets: revalidated often enough that a corrected chart reaches readers, cached long enough at the edge to be free.
Content-hashed assets never change under the same name.
